name: Wikipedia iOS (arm64, three agents, real tasks)
description: https://github.com/wikimedia/wikipedia-ios: Swift and Objective-C, local packages WMFData (imported by ~300 app files) and WMFComponents. Three agents at the same time, each with a small task judged by a build and its own new unit test: a wikitext helper and a URL helper in WMFData, a layout helper in WMFComponents. Each task first writes code that does not compile, fixes it, adds a test class, runs that class and builds the app. Plain: git worktree + scripts/setup_bundle_id ci, xcodebuild into the default DerivedData, tests on the simulator named in the command. xcfs: a pool warmed first (timed), then xcfs check / build / test. One architecture.

plain.build: xcodebuild build -project Wikipedia.xcodeproj -scheme Wikipedia -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64
plain.test: xcodebuild test -project Wikipedia.xcodeproj -scheme {scheme} -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64{only}
plain.check: xcodebuild build -project Wikipedia.xcodeproj -scheme {scheme} -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64
